sec-bot: automated-scan detected CVE-2026-4821 in pyyaml (<=6.0) used in repo infra-tools. CVSS: 7.8, EPSS: 0.42. files: backend/deps/requirements.txt :eyes:
Marta G.: saw the alert. @Owen can you confirm whether we call `yaml.load` anywhere with untrusted input? any public PoC? quick take on patch/backport needs?
Owen: doing a quick grep now — found `yaml.load(` in infra-tools/scripts/config_loader.py and a couple of legacy admin scripts under tools/legacy. No usage in runtime services (api/*).
Owen: public PoC not obvious from quick search. EPSS isn't tiny but exploit complexity looks medium because it needs crafted stream. I can open PR to pin pyyaml==6.0.1 in infra-tools and run CI.
Kai C.: I ran `gh code search` and checked exploit-db — nothing that drops a reliable remote PoC. From an exploitability standpoint: attack surface limited to places that parse untrusted yaml. Recommend: (1) patch infra-tools now, (2) add a short WAF rule to block suspicious yaml content patterns, (3) add audit logging for yaml deserializations.
Marta G.: good. Also think about short-term mitigation: block old infra-tools pipeline runs that use the vulnerable image. Can we add an RBAC constraint or denylist so old cron jobs can't execute until patched? @Lara can you own rollout plan?
Lara: I can. Plan: canary deploy patched infra-tools to staging tomorrow 10:00 UTC, run `./scripts/test-yaml.sh` smoke, promote to prod if green within 30m. Rollback if >2 failures or parse errors spike. Will add an audit log entry and a KMS-access review if any secret parsing is involved. Need owner & PR to reference.
Owen: owner = @Owen. Test plan: unit tests around config parsing + staging smoke. commands to run locally:
```
# run parser tests
pytest tests/test_config_parser.py::test_safe_load
# smoke against staging
./scripts/test-yaml.sh staging
```
I'll open PR locking pyyaml to 6.0.1 and include CI job to run the above. :thumbsup:
Kai C.: for prioritization I'm marking this P2 (high) — CVSS 7.8 but limited reach. I'll update the ticket with EPSS and scanner artifacts and add temporary alert: `yaml_deserialize_errors > 5` to catch regression.
Marta G.: solid. please drop PR link and ticket id here once they exist. Also add a blurb for the runbook about what to do if a PoC appears (isolate jobs, rotate KMS keys if any secrets may have been parsed).
